properties.name: fromEmail
properties.description: Email address of the sender optional with name

properties.name: toEmail
properties.description: Email address of the recipient. Multiple ones can be separated by comma.

properties.name: ccEmail
properties.description: Cc Email address of the recipient. Multiple ones can be separated by comma.

properties.name: bccEmail
properties.description: Bcc Email address of the recipient. Multiple ones can be separated by comma.

properties.name: replyTo
properties.description: Reply-To header. Recipients will use this address when replying.

properties.name: customHeaders
properties.description: Arbitrary email headers. Enter only the header name (e.g. X-Custom-Header); the h: prefix is added automatically.

values.name: name
values.description: Header name (without h: prefix; it is added automatically)

properties.name: tags
properties.description: Tags for segmentation and analytics (comma-separated). Sent as o:tag.

properties.name: attachments
properties.description: Name of the binary properties which contain data which should be added to email as attachment. Multiple ones can be comma-separated.
